description: Frequently Asked Questions Why should I work with a professional business Intermediary Consultant? You know how to run your business, you do it everyday. We know how to sell businesses, we do it every day. When you have legal issues you work with your attorney. When you have financial issues you work with your CPA. When you are ready to buy or sell a business, you work with us. Working with a professional business intermediary consultant ensures you receive expert guidance throughout the complex process of buying and selling a business. We help you maximize the value of your company, evaluate a potential acquisition, navigate legal and financial complexities, and we connect you with qualified buyers and sellers—all while handling the details so you can focus on your business until the deal is closed. What does your service cost? We operate on a success-based model, meaning there are no upfront fees or risks to you. We only get paid once your business is successfully sold, ensuring our priorities are fully aligned with achieving the best outcome for you. What is my business worth? Only “The Market” really knows! The value of your business depends on various standard factors, including financial performance, market conditions, industry trends, and the strength of your management team. However there are also situational factors like what direct and indirect competitors are for sale at the same time. We take all these elements into account, present your business to qualified buyers and provide you with an accurate estimate of your business’s worth based on the market. In addition, we also look at external data in the market and competitive analysis to give you a suggested fair asking price. What do I need to do to get the process started? To get started, simply Click Here to schedule an introductory call with one of our professional consultants. title: High-Volume Long-Established Family Restaurant DeKalb County – Over 55 Years!
description: Summary: Become the next owner of one of DeKalb County's most recognized and enduring family restaurants.  Successfully serving the community for more than 55 years, this highly respected independent restaurant has built an outstanding reputation for exceptional and made-from-scratch comfort food and hospitality, plus an incredibly loyal multigenerational customer base. This is a true turnkey operation that has become a local institution, attracting repeat guests who have been dining here for decades while continually welcoming new customers from surrounding schools, businesses, neighborhoods and visitors to the area. Many families have made this restaurant part of their weekly tradition, creating an exceptionally stable foundation for continued success. Their menu features an extensive selection of breakfast, lunch and dinner favorites, with its all-day breakfast as one of the restaurant's biggest traffic drivers.  Guests return time and again for hearty skillets, omelets, pancakes and waffles, as well as fresh salads, homemade soups, sandwiches, burgers, hand-cut steaks and other comfort food classics, plus rotating daily specials.  Its broad menu appeals to customers of every age and demographic, generating consistent business throughout the day and week. Also, the diner’s warm and welcoming dining room offers a nostalgic atmosphere unlike anything else on the market.  Its unique theme and classic décor has created a memorable dining experience that has delighted generations of guests and differentiates the restaurant from typical diners and chains. Coupled with the restaurant’s commitment to quality ingredients, homemade recipes and attentive service has resulted in an extremely loyal customer following, strong word-of-mouth referrals and decades of repeat business. title: High-Volume Sports Bar, Grill & Live Entertainment Venue w/Gaming Western Suburb of Chicago – Sales Over $966,000
description: Summary: An incredible opportunity to acquire a thriving neighborhood bar & grill in a highly desirable western suburb. A well-established pub that has built a strong local following by combining great food, creative cocktails, sports viewing, live entertainment and video gaming in a lively social atmosphere all under one roof. This turnkey operation offers a dynamic blend of revenue streams including food sales, liquor sales, live music/theme nights, gaming income and private events.  Known for its, hearty American comfort food, award-winning cocktails, weekly entertainment programming and energetic atmosphere.  Popular with families, friends, coworkers, sports fans, live music patrons and gaming enthusiasts alike. Its spacious interior features a full-service bar, comfortable dining areas, multiple TVs and projection screens for sports viewing, an entertainment space for live bands and events, plus a semi-private gaming area.  All in an inviting tavern-style atmosphere designed to encourage repeat business and extended guest stays. Weekly programming currently includes trivia-style events, bingo, themed entertainment nights, live music performances and other customer-driving promotions that create strong weekday and weekend traffic.  The operation also accommodates private parties, and group events, as well as off-site catering. Its impressive menu offers an approachable mix of relaxed comfort food and upscale pub favorites including starters, burgers, salads, wraps, handhelds and chef-inspired specialties that appeal to a broad demographic.  Plus, signature offerings and drink specials that have helped create strong customer loyalty and repeat visitation. Business Highlights • Broad menu with wide demographic appeal • Mouthwatering dishes made with the finest ingredients • Full bar with strong cocktail program • Multiple TVs & projection screens • Strong sports-bar & nightlife atmosphere • Additional live entertainment & event-driven revenue • Substantial gaming

title: First Choice Business Brokers Pittsburgh
description: Benefits Of Selling Your Business 1) Generates Liquidity for You When you sell your business, you generate liquidity, which is the ability to convert assets to cash quickly and easily. This can be handy if you need access to cash quickly or if you want to invest in another business venture, pay off debts, or simply enjoy a more comfortable lifestyle. 2) Protects Employees Selling your business protects your employees by giving them a sense of stability and certainty. They know that their jobs are in safe hands and that the company will continue to operate smoothly, albeit under new management. This can help reduce stress levels and increase morale. It also gives them a chance to continue working in an environment they are familiar with and comfortable with. 3) Cut Losses Your business may be struggling, and you want to recoup some of your investment before the business fails. By selling the business, you can salvage some value from it instead of losing everything. In short, selling a business is a proactive measure taken to avoid future losses. 4) Sell at a Higher Price If market conditions are favorable, you will receive a higher price for your business. This is because buyers will pay more when the market is good. Also, the demand for businesses is higher when the economy is doing well, so more buyers are looking to purchase businesses. 5) Pursue Other Projects You will become free by selling your business to pursue other projects. This is because you are no longer responsible for running the business, which can take up a lot of time and energy. It is also a great way to diversify your portfolio and income streams and explore new areas of interest. 6) Spend More Time with Family When you sell your business, you'll no longer be tied down to the business's day-to-day operations. Instead, you'll be able to focus on your relationships and enjoy your free time. This can be a great way to bond and build lasting relationships. ﻿ Request A Valuation
